name: midgame_board_shift_MB
version: v2 2026-11-11 PC2 research: applied after the 0.6.4 probability temperature (prob_temperature_v1, SHA 5bb39a21...)
status: candidate for 0.6.5. 152-video all-row test in product order passed; 60-video folds 2 and 3 slightly worse (recorded as variation inside the discovery set); final check by live replay pending; newsealed not used
order: p_B3 (averaged raw) -> temperature (src/prob_temperature.py, unchanged) -> this layer: logit(p_final) = logit(p_temperature) + shift

all_of: max(phase(cells_total_p1), phase(cells_total_p2)) == midgame, where phase(n) = early if n <= 18, late if n >= 48, else midgame
the counter-fire window of shift_1b is NOT active (PC1 decision 11/11: counter-fire shift has priority)
both sides have a kept settled_board in the current game (otherwise shift = 0)
layer.counter_fire_window_note: in the research evaluation the window was approximated as 1.5 s after any chain start (chain_active rising edge of either side), a superset of the product window; 290 of 289,785 layer rows (0.10%) overlapped and were set to 0

features.source: the causal confirmed_board stream per side (observation side.confirmed_board, the same stream SideState.board reads)
features.settled_board: a confirmed_board that is settled (no floating cell, no connected group of 4 or more of one color among colors 1-5) and has no UNKNOWN (10) cell
features.carry_forward: per side, keep the most recent settled_board seen at or before the row's frame, and use it until the next settled_board arrives. Only boards from the current game (frame >= first frame of the game) count.
features.color: number of cells with value 1-5 on the kept settled_board, all 13 rows including the hidden row
features.bump: sum over adjacent columns i=1..5 of |h_i - h_(i+1)|, where h_c = number of non-empty cells (value > 0) in column c over all 13 rows
features.delta: d_color = color(1P) - color(2P); d_bump = bump(1P) - bump(2P)

shift.fit: offset logistic on the 60 discovery videos' settled pairs (color difference 0-4), offset = temperature * logit(5-fold out-of-fold B3 s1003 student), temperature from prob_temperature_v1 with the product's stratum assignment; game-equal weights; no player strength
shift.cap: s_capped = clip(s, -0.25, +0.25) logit (binds on 0.16% of layer rows)
shift.symmetry: antisymmetric: swapping 1P and 2P flips the sign; no intercept

mixing.enter: when a row enters the layer, apply s_capped * min(1, (t - t_enter) / 0.5 s)
mixing.exit: after leaving the layer, apply last_applied_shift * exp(-(t - t_exit) / 1.0 s), where last_applied_shift is the shift of the last in-layer row
mixing.counter_fire: if the counter-fire window becomes active while decaying, the remaining shift becomes 0 and stays 0 until the layer is entered again
mixing.game_boundary: state resets at the start of each game
mixing.color_difference_edge: no extra weakening (the variant halving the shift at |d| = 4 was worse)

evaluation_152_videos_product_order.rows_scored: 349,602 rows (layer rows 289,495 and decay rows) / 7,437 games
evaluation_152_videos_product_order.double_correction_check: temperature reduces the layer's gain from -0.00073 (without temperature) to -0.00058, so part overlaps, but the layer still improves LL and halves ECE after the temperature

robustness_one_cell: a wrong color does not change color or bump; a missing or extra cell changes bump by <= 2 and color by 1 (<= about 0.05 logit)
cost: counting cells and column heights on one settled board per side: negligible
